limitations: Collection progress is not an audited dataset freeze or a model accuracy result.
Sealed session C labels, image data and frame index are not opened by collection readiness. Its test counts remain unavailable until final acceptance.

One immutable original source must retain one session, role and device. Disjoint-frame reimports cannot create independent validation data; all conflicting source copies are excluded. Legacy sealed assignments without saved source hashes still need a provenance audit.

Rallies require explicit complete-original-rally review and source-specific IDs. No-ball duration is credited only for explicit complete-original-interval review with all decoded frames and immutable source/image/timestamp audit; sparse saved images cannot establish it.

Exact duplicate images and conflicting source labels are excluded here. Near-duplicate cross-split leakage, independent session capture, second-pass annotation review and frozen manifests still need audit.

Positive temporal windows require three consecutive reviewed box-positive original images, a saved continuity audit and an explicitly reviewed center/streak target on the latest frame. Box centers alone do not count as precise temporal targets.
